short: Exact factoring, fixed finite gate set

title.title: Exact quantum factoring over a fixed finite gate set
title.subtitle: Claim: poly-time circuits over one finite gate set factor every $N \ge 2$ completely, with probability 1

beats.text: Shor's algorithm succeeds with high probability, using arbitrary rotation angles
Claim: one fixed finite gate set factors every $N \ge 2$ completely, with no error at all

achievement.label: Is factoring in exact quantum polynomial time?
achievement.context: Before: Shor (1994) errs with small probability; exact variants needed continuous angles
achievement.note: A complexity refinement, not a faster algorithm

verify.detail: Exact polynomial-time factoring is in Lean; the formal circuit model should be audited
verify.ourCheck: We compared the Lean scope with the claim; we did not build it

plain: Shor's quantum factoring works with high probability; this version always succeeds, with a fixed set of gates

steps: Factoring reduces to finding the order of a number, as in Shor
Make each order trial succeed with chance exactly one quarter
One exact amplification step turns that quarter into certainty

voice.text: Shor's algorithm usually succeeds. This circuit, using one fixed gate set, always does.
Make each trial succeed exactly one time in four, then amplify that to certainty.
Claimed: exact factoring in polynomial time.
